summary: tools/audio/fetch.py (stdlib only) downloads, verifies (size + SHA-256) and safely unpacks the 57 entries of assets/audio/downloads.json: 5 Kenney CC0 packs and 52 NASA-hosted files, 329.3 MB on disk. CREDITS.md (generated, 470 file rows plus licence evidence and the not-taken list) and selection.json (50 files) exist and agree with the disk.
verified: deleted downloads/kenney-ui-audio: --check reported it missing, fetch.py --only kenney-ui-audio re-downloaded and unpacked it, full --check passed again
fetch.py --credits is reproducible: output identical after the clean rebuild (cmp)
all 50 selected files open with soundfile (no librosa fallback needed) with positive duration; excerpts lie inside the file durations; categories exist in sounds.json
Kenney: each pack page says CC0 and each archive License.txt names CC0 (read in this session)
free disk afterwards about 259 GB of 2047 GB (12.7 %)
notVerified: No file was listened to; titles and intents come from page text and file names
speech flags and the excerpt of Apollo 11 day 5 and the ISS calls come from level and modulation heuristics or titles, not from hearing or transcription
interior ambience of a station or spacecraft was not found on any NASA host (gap, listed in not taken)
NASA image-library items carry no explicit rights line in their metadata; the basis is NASA's media usage guidelines
deviations: 52 NASA files instead of the 15 to 40 aimed at (the Mars and plasma material is small)
.url files in the Kenney archives are not extracted (allowed by the brief but useless and a double-click risk)
Kenney links are short-lived signed links; fetch.py resolves them through kenney.nl/download-link with the pack page as Referer
the 15 speech files include identifiable astronaut and controller voices: CREDITS.md says they are test material, not for shipping without a decision
openIssues: Kenney pages carry a robots noai / tdm-reservation tag; noted in CREDITS.md
the Voyager interstellar sounds link is dead (404)
the selection picks excerpts for 15 long files; the owner should confirm by ear
forNextAgent: Run .venv-audio/Scripts/python.exe -I tools/audio/fetch.py to rebuild assets/audio/downloads/ (about 40 s), --check to verify, --credits to regenerate CREDITS.md. Selection files are paths relative to assets/audio/downloads; speech true marks 15 clips for radio filter tests; excerpt is [start, end] in seconds.
